episodes.synopsis: The Stardust Crusaders meet a new addition to their group-a dog named Iggy who is actually the user of The Fool Stand.
episodes.title: Iggy the Fool and N'Dool the GEB (Part I)

episodes.synopsis: The Stardust Crusaders are pitted against another of DIO's assassins-N'Doul and his deadly water Stand, the Egyptian god Geb.
episodes.title: Iggy the Fool and N'Dool the GEB (Part. II)

episodes.synopsis: The Stardust Crusaders encounter a gambler named D'Arby who claims to have information they need. They have to beat him in the ultimate wager-one where their very souls are at stake thanks to the use of his Stand Osiris.
episodes.title: D'Arby the Gambler

episodes.synopsis: The Stardust Crusaders arrive at Dio's lair, but Dio's finest assassin, Vanilla Ice, slay Avdol before their horrified eyes. Polnareff and Iggy take on Vanilla Ice while the others go after Dio.
episodes.title: Dio's World: The Warrior of the Void: Vanilla Ice

episodes.synopsis: Kakyoin steps up to face Dio, but finds himself fatally outclassed.
episodes.title: Dio's World: Kakyoin - Duel in the Barrier

episodes.synopsis: The century-old blood feud finally comes to a close in the final battle between Jotaro and Dio.
episodes.title: Dio's World: Farewell, My Friends
